title: Read the work graph from the coordinator's index, across the API and the service
goal: NERV serves the coordinator's work graph, or says the index is unreachable
acceptance: The `work_graph` tool joins the coordinator server's read grants (read-only, a writing tool still refused); `GET /api/live-index/graph` returns the payload with its snapshot time and source links, or an unreachable answer that is never shown as no work
A test across the CLI grants, the service and the API with a fake index, committed failing first: a graph with a critical path, a problem entry, the index stopped
The guide remote-mcp.md names the new tool
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: One more read grant and one more API answer next to the live index's; the reading code and the tools process already carry structuredContent. Estimated 2026-11-27. Not a measurement.
